ResearchProjectDef.label: Mechanicum manufactorum
ResearchProjectDef.description: The knowledge to raise a Mechanicum manufactorum: the forge-temple where every part and weapon of an Imperial Knight is made, ready to be assembled in a Knight hangar. Requires basic mechtech and advanced fabrication.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Armiger Knights
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the Armiger Knight at the Mechanicum manufactorum: The smallest of the Knight engines: a fast, lightly armoured walker with two arm-mounted autocannons and a carapace heavy stubber. Piloted from a throne in the carapace.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Questoris Knights
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the Questoris Knight at the Mechanicum manufactorum: The line Knight of the great houses. A thermal cannon on one arm, a rapid-fire battle cannon on the other, and twin carapace heavy stubbers. Piloted from a throne in the carapace.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Dominus Knights
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the Dominus Knight at the Mechanicum manufactorum: A siege-class engine. The Castellan pattern carries a plasma decimator and a Titan-killing volcano lance; the Valiant a conflagration cannon and a thundercoil harpoon. Shieldbreaker missiles and twin siegebreaker cannons ride its carapace, twin meltaguns flank its head. Piloted by a single noble through the Throne Mechanicum.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Cerastus Knights
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the Cerastus Knight at the Mechanicum manufactorum: A fast, specialised war machine of the Cerastus patterns (Acheron, Atrapos, Castigator, Lancer), each built around one signature weapon. Piloted by a single noble through the Throne Mechanicum.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Acastus Knights
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the Acastus Knight at the Mechanicum manufactorum: A slow, towering fire-support engine (Porphyrion) carrying the heaviest guns of any Knight, built to break fortresses. Piloted by a single noble through the Throne Mechanicum.
